candidates.yourNature_desc: You carry that cutting edge into conversations that only asked for company. A loose excuse catches your attention and you pull it apart, even when the evening could have continued without a correction. You have the energy to keep going. Being right doesn't tell you when to stop, and a clean answer can leave more distance between you and the person who asked.

self_card.presence: You bring the whole blade to small doubts. A passing remark gets as much force as a question that needs a serious answer.

$original.yourNature_desc: You are what the sword is like when it wakes up as a person. The cut is always ready and mostly used. You put the truth ahead of comfort, yours and everyone's, every day, in every setting. People bring you the questions nobody else will answer straight, then flinch at exactly what they asked for. The edge never rests. That includes the nights, and it includes you.

self_card.presence: The cut is always available and mostly used. Clarity this constant is a climate, and the people near you dress for it.
